fields.status: The latest release is v1.4.0, published 2026-10-03. The maintainer reports campaign, skirmish, Generals Challenge, touch controls, audio, cutscenes, real online matches, and PC cross-play. Device notes name a Poco F8 Pro (Adreno 830) and Redmi Note 8 Pro (Mali-G76); GLES is the default renderer, while Vulkan has device-specific limits. The README does not state a minimum Android version.
